relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: the change over time in MIDAS, HIT-6, MMDs and MDA scores (median, IQR) was statistically significant for erenumab and galcanezumab treatment from baseline to the end of observation

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: the change over time in MIDAS, HIT-6, MMDs and MDA scores (median, IQR) was statistically significant for erenumab and galcanezumab treatment from baseline to the end of observation

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: The CGRP is released from activated trigeminal nerve terminals which binds to specific receptors on brain vessels and mast cells promoting vasodilation and mast cell degranulation

key_findings: In 205 patients, erenumab and galcanezumab significantly improved MIDAS, HIT-6, MMD and MAD over 13 months; fremanezumab did not reach significance at endpoint due to small sample.
